after_snippet:
from packaging.specifiers import Specifier
spec = Specifier('>=1.0')
# In 26.0, contains returns False for invalid versions instead of raising
result = spec.contains('not-a-valid-version')
assert result is False
before_snippet:
from packaging.specifiers import Specifier
spec = Specifier('>=1.0')
# In 25.0, passing an invalid version string raises an exception
try:
    spec.contains('not-a-valid-version')
    assert False, 'Should have raised'
except Exception:
    pass
title: Specifier.contains returns False instead of raising for invalid versions
